anonymousAnalyticsDetail: Shares installs, sessions, puzzle results, stars and feature usage. Advertising identifiers, piece positions, contacts and precise location are not sent to analytics.
privacyPolicyIntro: Qybeq works without an account. This policy explains what is stored on your device and what may be sent to our service providers.
privacyLocalBody: Your settings, puzzle progress, stars, unlocked themes and Daily Challenge streak are stored locally on your device. Qybeq does not upload where you put the pieces and does not ask for your name, email address or contacts.
privacyAnalyticsBody: Qybeq sends technical app and device information plus events such as app starts, puzzle starts and completions, completion time, stars earned, hints and theme usage to Yandex AppMetrica. Advertising identifier collection, precise location and cross-app tracking are disabled for analytics. You can turn analytics off in Settings at any time.
privacyAdsBody: When you voluntarily request an extra hint or solution, Yandex Mobile Ads may show a rewarded video and process technical device and advertising data needed to deliver, secure and measure the ad. On iOS, only Apple's App Tracking Transparency prompt asks whether the advertising identifier may be used for personalized ads. If you decline, rewarded videos remain available without personalization. Precise location is disabled. If a hint ad is unavailable, Qybeq grants the hint for free.
privacyNotificationsBody: Daily Challenge reminders are scheduled locally on your device. They are off by default and can be enabled or disabled in Settings.
privacyChoicesBody: You can disable analytics, notifications, music and sound in Qybeq Settings. On iOS, tracking permission can be changed in the device Settings. Deleting Qybeq removes its locally stored progress and preferences. Qybeq has no user account or cloud profile to delete.
privacyPartnersBody:
Yandex privacy policy: https://yandex.com/legal/confidential/
AppMetrica privacy and data documentation: https://appmetrica.yandex.ru/docs/en/data-security/
privacyChildrenBody: Qybeq is a general-audience puzzle game and does not knowingly collect names, contact details or precise location from children.
privacyContactBody: For privacy questions, contact us at muxaujish@gmail.com.

reminderMessage2: A new daily cube is ready.
reminderMessage4: Try the daily challenge without a hint.
howBoardBody: Every puzzle starts with a throw: one die falls into each layer of the cube and takes a cell. Every other cell has to be filled.
howPiecesBody: The pieces in the tray hold exactly as many cells as the dice leave free. The bigger cubes come with a new set every time.
howRotateBody: Drag the cube to look at it from every side. See through and Layers show what is inside.
howFlipBody: Pick a piece, then use Turn, Tilt and Spin. Pieces never need mirroring: turning reaches every position.
howPlaceBody: Drag a piece onto the cube: it goes in from your side as deep as it can. The outline shows where it lands. Tap the arrows to move it a cell.
howFillBody: Fill every free cell, with no gaps. Any arrangement that fills the cube solves it.
diceFill: One die falls into each layer
